sections.heading: What we use
sections.body: To suggest recipes we use the ingredients you give us (from a photo, typing, or your voice), plus the diet, allergies, meal type, cooking tools, and time limit you choose. If you make an account we also keep your saved recipes and ratings.

sections.heading: Photos
sections.body: Photos are made smaller on your device before they are uploaded. We send them to Google's Gemini AI to find the ingredients in them, and Google handles them under its own terms. Your photo history in the app is saved on your device. Our FAQ has more on how photos are used.

sections.heading: Voice input
sections.body: Voice input uses your browser's built-in speech recognition. Depending on your browser, the audio may be processed by the browser's company (for example Google for Chrome).

sections.heading: Other services we use
sections.body: We send your photos or ingredient list to Google's Gemini AI to find ingredients, and we use Spoonacular to find recipes. Spoonacular only gets your ingredient list and filters.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can always type or say your ingredients instead of using a photo. You can delete your photo history in your profile or by clearing this site's data in your browser. To remember that you accepted this note, we save a random id in your browser.
